Sunny, Rai, and friends at Deths Birthday

6-player game
Played with expansions: - [thing=2807]Catan: 5-6 Player Expansion[/thing]

Josh won the highest die roll and picked a mediocre spot that had two 5 hexes connected. Ben took a nice port spot with the second pick. Eli took the most optimal spot with three 8s on 2 different hexes. I took a nice spot with commodity upsides. Nick got screwed but was able to start a long road with back to back picks. Eli and Ben started off extremely hot getting all the lumber and grain. I made the first knight to add to Catan’s defense. Eli followed my lead and also cut off Nick from the outside ports. Nick then waged war against Eli trading Robber attacks back and forth. After I built the first city the Robber wars ended. A huge trading renaissance started and a golden age began. I took the Green metropolis and built 2 more cities. Nick took the longest road and built 2 more settlements. Josh got messed with and had an abundance of brick. Ben had a rough time and didn’t get many die rolls his way. Eli was living as the merchant king. He profited off the best hexes and the best rolls going his way. He took my metropolis and then built another one with the yellow guild. Eli also built 2 more cities. Eli and I were the only ones to recruit knights and defend Catan. I had 3 level 3 Knights and got 3 Saviors of Catan, Eli had 2. In the end I built one more settlement and upgraded to a city and took my Metropolis from Eli to secure the victory
